name: jump_hash
description: Assigns a 64-bit key to one of `buckets` buckets with Jump consistent hash: when the bucket count grows from n to n + 1, only about 1/(n + 1) of keys move. Hash the value first, e.g. jump_hash(xxh3_64(x), n). Matches Guava's Hashing.consistentHash

name: iceberg_hash
description: Computes Iceberg's 32-bit bucket hash of the input (spec Appendix B): MurmurHash3 x86_32 with seed 0 over Iceberg's encoding of the value. Integers of every width hash alike, DECIMAL hashes its unscaled value and timestamps hash as microseconds

name: spark_xxhash64
